title: Concept: Swagger UI documentation exposed in a response
description: The Swagger UI page loads an OpenAPI document and renders every route, parameter and model. The rendered catalogue tells a reader which endpoints exist and how they are shaped, which is the reconnaissance step before targeted requests.
applicability: Responses that render Swagger UI on a reachable path.
risk: The full API catalogue is readable; LOW severity because the documentation names the surface without granting access.
